_provenance: Manuscript Results section, Table 1. Paragraphs describing six structural failure mechanisms identified through conceptual synthesis.
_caveat: This is a structured conceptual synthesis, not a systematic review. Governance gap column reflects the author's interpretive assessment.
table_title: Table 1. Synthesis provenance: failure mechanisms, structural descriptions, literature sources, and governance gaps.

data.structural_description: Metric bears only indirect causal relationship to the harm it purports to control
data.key_sources: Suresh & Guttag 2021 [16]; Wiens et al 2019 [17]; Char et al 2018 [15]
data.governance_gap: Most frameworks accept metric achievement as sufficient; causal chain to harm not required

data.structural_description: Uniform thresholds applied across settings with materially different risk profiles
data.key_sources: Coiera 2019 [20]; Obermeyer et al 2019 [4]; Kelly et al 2019 [3]; FUTURE-AI [26]
data.governance_gap: EU AI Act Annex IV requires deployment context but does not mandate threshold re-specification per context

data.structural_description: Multi-metric governance systems assess thresholds independently; compound failure modes remain undetected
data.key_sources: Leveson 2011 [7]; Rajkomar et al 2019 [1]; Parasuraman & Manzey 2010 [21]
data.governance_gap: Least addressed in current standards; ISO 42001 references risk interaction but provides no methodology

data.structural_description: Hard cutoffs create incentives to optimise the metric rather than improve underlying safety
data.key_sources: Thomas & Uminsky 2022 [19]; Goodhart 1981 [18]; Raji et al 2020 [6]
data.governance_gap: Algorithmic audit independence principles address gaming but are not mandated

data.structural_description: Quantifiable performance metrics crowd out harder-to-measure sociotechnical risks
data.key_sources: Selbst et al 2019 [13]; Ibrahim et al 2021 [28]; Vokinger et al 2021 [22]
data.governance_gap: WHO 2021/2024 [14] addresses sociotechnical risks qualitatively; no quantitative governance counterpart

data.structural_description: Threshold justified at initial audit loses validity as population, data pipeline, or system version changes
data.key_sources: FDA PCCP 2023 [9]; Subbaswamy & Saria 2020; FDA SaMD 2021 [8]; FDA 2025 [27]
data.governance_gap: FDA PCCP and EU AI Act Art. 72 address monitoring but do not require prespecified threshold re-evaluation triggers
